ncfe5e37af3.headline: IMF Urges Kenya to Establish Clear Crypto Regulations to Tackle AML/CFT Risks
ncfe5e37af3.summary: The IMF has urged Kenya to establish a robust regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies to protect consumers and address money laundering and terrorism financing risks.
ncfe5e37af3.why: The IMF advises governments on macroeconomic and financial stability, and crypto rules affect how digital-asset firms can operate.

n3c565c4f6f.headline: Ares Management Raises Over $2.3 Billion of Equity Commitments to Support the Long-Term Growth of Aspida
n3c565c4f6f.summary: Ares Management has raised over $2.3 billion of equity commitments to support the long-term growth of Aspida. Aspida has over $1.5 billion of dry powder.
n3c565c4f6f.why: Ares is a large US alternative asset manager, and capital commitments to insurers like Aspida support retirement-income business growth.

n729a9e7162.headline: 'Short and sharp': Expert's forecast on house price drop
n729a9e7162.summary: The national house price index has dropped for the first time in two years. Experts expect the downturn to be shallow and short-lived.
n729a9e7162.why: House prices affect household wealth, mortgage risk and the banking sector, and they influence Reserve Bank policy.

n989011bc35.headline: Cash-strapped Dutch museums nervous about future despite last-minute VAT reprieve
n989011bc35.summary: Dutch museums were relieved after the government withdrew a tax-raising plan, but remain worried about possible funding cuts.
n989011bc35.why: Tax and budget decisions affect the finances of cultural institutions and public spending priorities in the Netherlands.

source.name: The Art Newspaper - International art news and events

sources.name: The Art Newspaper - International art news and events

nb5467321c1.headline: The Senate parliamentarian could block some of Trump's agenda — and be a scapegoat for Republicans
nb5467321c1.summary: Senate Majority Leader John Thune says he will follow the parliamentarian's rulings, though he will face pressure not to. The rulings could block parts of Trump's agenda.
nb5467321c1.why: The Senate parliamentarian rules on whether budget measures comply with procedural rules, which determines what policy can pass by simple majority.

n29f1d525c4.headline: Mozambique’s default risk rises as unrest persists
n29f1d525c4.summary: Opposition leader Venâncio Mondlane, who claims October's election was stolen, returned to Maputo after nearly two months in exile. Default risk on Mozambique's debt has risen as unrest persists.
n29f1d525c4.why: Sovereign default risk shapes borrowing costs and bond prices for frontier-market governments, and political instability is a key driver of that risk.

nf97075d5fb.headline: US: Donald Trump issues veiled threat, says open to use military might to take control of Greenland, Panama Canal
nf97075d5fb.summary: President-elect Donald Trump said he would not dismiss using military force to secure control of the Panama Canal or Greenland.
nf97075d5fb.why: The Panama Canal is a key global shipping route, and Greenland is a Danish territory with strategic and mineral significance, so statements about them affect trade and geopolitical risk.

n5fe82b6b69.headline: Transnistria still considers Russia as main gas supplier — foreign minister
n5fe82b6b69.summary: Transnistria's foreign minister Vitaly Ignatyev said it still considers Russia its main gas supplier and that supplies via the TurkStream pipeline require political decisions.
n5fe82b6b69.why: TurkStream is a Russian gas pipeline to Europe via Turkey, and gas supply routes are central to energy security and prices in the region.

n7c166e810b.headline: Cyprus Business Now: fiscal surplus, hotel investment, funds association
n7c166e810b.summary: Cyprus recorded a historically high surplus of €1.42 billion between January and November 2024, equal to 4.2 per cent of GDP. The figure is preliminary Cystat data.
n7c166e810b.why: Fiscal balances signal public finance health, which influences sovereign credit ratings and borrowing costs.

n4b0765dd1b.headline: Cold Water, No Heating: Transnistria Struggles After Russia Cuts Gas
n4b0765dd1b.summary: Transnistria's authorities have shut factories, closed schools and urged residents to collect firewood after Russia cut gas supplies. The region had relied on Moscow's cheap energy for decades.
n4b0765dd1b.why: Energy cutoffs in breakaway regions show how gas supply disruptions can halt industrial output and public services.

n73b23e6d74.headline: Gas More Expensive Than Oil Sets Stage for Asian Fuel Switching
n73b23e6d74.summary: A rally in liquefied natural gas has pushed Asian prices to a rare and substantial premium over oil, setting up fuel switching in Asia.
n73b23e6d74.why: Asian LNG prices are a benchmark for gas-fired power and industry, and when they exceed oil, buyers may switch to oil-based fuels.

n7ca156dc63.headline: Russian guided bomb attack kills 13 in Zaporizhzhia; Kyiv hits oil depot deep in Russia
n7ca156dc63.summary: A Russian guided bomb attack killed at least 13 people and injured 29 in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine, while Kyiv struck an oil depot deep inside Russia.
n7ca156dc63.why: Attacks on energy infrastructure in Russia and Ukraine can affect regional fuel supply and global oil and gas market sentiment.

n89874be92a.headline: California insurance crisis: List of carriers that have fled or reduced coverage in the state
n89874be92a.summary: California has seen an exodus of property insurance companies in recent years, and ongoing wildfires threaten to worsen the problem. The article lists carriers that have fled or reduced coverage.
n89874be92a.why: Property insurers price and underwrite wildfire and catastrophe risk, and shrinking capacity affects homeowners, housing markets and insurer earnings.

n3c3834c54e.headline: US dollar exchange rate continues to decline in Iraq
n3c3834c54e.summary: The exchange rate for the US dollar against the Iraqi dinar declined on Thursday in Baghdad and Erbil. The move was reported for trading in both cities.
n3c3834c54e.why: The dinar's exchange rate affects import costs and inflation in Iraq, where the economy relies heavily on oil revenue.

impacts.name: Iraqi dinar
impacts.why: A lower US dollar rate against the dinar means the dinar has strengthened.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n84c9f4f729.headline: Afyren:  new financing secured for plant project
n84c9f4f729.summary: Afyren has secured new financing of 10 million euros to fund its biorefinery project in the Grand-Est region of France. The greentech company said the funding supports the plant project.
n84c9f4f729.why: Afyren is a French greentech company producing bio-based chemicals through fermentation. Its financing shows how small industrial biotech projects depend on capital markets and public support.

naf28cb0aa3.headline: Bank of Mexico board opens door to larger rate cuts
naf28cb0aa3.summary: Bank of Mexico board members opened the door to larger benchmark rate cuts at future meetings as inflation eases, according to minutes from the central bank.
naf28cb0aa3.why: Bank of Mexico sets interest rates for Latin America's second-largest economy, influencing the peso, bond yields and borrowing costs.

n509a6944f0.headline: Iraq exports oil worth over $5 billion to US in 11 months
n509a6944f0.summary: The value of Iraqi oil exports to the United States topped $5 billion in the first 11 months of 2024. The figure shows the scale of Iraq's crude sales to the US market.
n509a6944f0.why: Iraq is one of OPEC's largest oil producers, and its export revenues drive much of its government budget. Shifts in its crude sales affect global supply and regional oil flows.

n2b08369fdb.headline: How planned telecoms tariff hike will help reduce inflation — Rewane
n2b08369fdb.summary: Bismarck Rewane of Financial Derivatives has said a proposed increase in telecoms tariffs would help reduce inflation in Nigeria. The article's details on the tariff size are not included.
n2b08369fdb.why: Telecom tariffs feed into household and business costs, which affect inflation measures tracked by Nigeria's central bank. Pricing decisions also shape the profitability of telecom operators.

n15ea8b5a36.headline: Lebanese Parliament Elects Army Commander as President, Ending 2-Year Vacuum
n15ea8b5a36.summary: Lebanon's parliament has chosen General Joseph Aoun as president, ending a two-year leadership vacuum. The country is facing ongoing crises.
n15ea8b5a36.why: Lebanon has been in a prolonged economic and banking crisis, and a functioning presidency is a prerequisite for reforms sought by international lenders. Political stability affects investor sentiment toward the country.

nb431810c0e.headline: CBN halts extension of export proceeds repatriation
nb431810c0e.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria has immediately suspended approvals for extensions of export proceeds repatriation for exporters. The move affects how exporters bring foreign earnings back to the country.
nb431810c0e.why: Repatriation rules govern how exporters convert and return foreign currency earnings, which affects naira liquidity and foreign exchange supply.

n5008730cd4.headline: Greggs issues warning to customers as it says price rises are a
n5008730cd4.summary: Greggs raised prices on a number of items in July 2024, including a 5p increase on sausage rolls. The company has issued a warning to customers about the price rises.
n5008730cd4.why: Greggs is a UK bakery chain, and its pricing decisions reflect food and labour cost trends that affect UK retail margins.

nd8541ebe74.headline: What's next for Canada? 5 questions will help decide the future after Trudeau
nd8541ebe74.summary: Canada must replace a lame-duck leader and cope with threats from Trump, according to analysts quoted in the report. The country's future direction after Trudeau is in question.
nd8541ebe74.why: Canada is a major trade partner of the US, so its leadership and policy stance affect trade flows, tariffs and the Canadian dollar.

source.name: Northern Public Radio: WNIJ and WNIU

sources.name: Northern Public Radio: WNIJ and WNIU

n9333f5713e.headline: Covestro to increase production at Ohio factory
n9333f5713e.summary: Covestro LLC, the Pittsburgh-based polymers manufacturer, said it would expand a factory in Ohio that makes polycarbonate compounds. The announcement was made on Wednesday.
n9333f5713e.why: Covestro is a German-listed chemicals and polymers producer, and its US capacity investments affect demand for its materials in automotive and electronics supply chains.

n4df61fd905.headline: Joseph Aoun, former army commander, elected as Lebanon's new president
n4df61fd905.summary: Lebanon's parliament swore in army commander Joseph Aoun as head of state after 13 failed attempts to elect a president. He is described as the preferred candidate.
n4df61fd905.why: Lebanon's economy has been under severe strain, and a settled presidency is closely watched by international lenders and investors weighing reform and recovery prospects.

n25697eb62b.headline: World Bank Approves $35 Million Project to Support Adolescent Empowerment in Meghalaya
n25697eb62b.summary: The World Bank has approved a $35 million project to help 500,000 adolescents in Meghalaya improve education, reduce dropout rates and access career opportunities.
n25697eb62b.why: World Bank approvals are development loans or grants that fund public programmes in member countries, including Indian states.

source.name: The Sentinel - of this Land, for its People

sources.name: The Sentinel - of this Land, for its People

n0293886f67.headline: Rachel Reeves dealt massive blow as Bank of England exposes huge problem
n0293886f67.summary: Firms project stagnating employment, lower wages and price increases for customers in the year ahead, according to the Bank of England's findings as reported. The input gives no further figures.
n0293886f67.why: The Bank of England sets UK interest rates, and its business surveys inform decisions on inflation and monetary policy.

nb1d1351417.headline: Malaysia sees GDP growth above 5% despite Trump tariff risks
nb1d1351417.summary: Malaysia's economy grew above 5%, with foreign investment and government initiatives seen helping to shield it from global risks, including Trump tariff threats.
nb1d1351417.why: Malaysia is a trade-exposed Southeast Asian economy, so growth rates and tariff exposure matter for regional investors.

n953f229ee0.headline: Biden set to push new Russia sanctions before Trump era begins
n953f229ee0.summary: President Joe Biden is expected to unveil new sanctions targeting Russia's economy this week, according to a US official, to bolster Kyiv's war effort before Donald Trump takes office.
n953f229ee0.why: Sanctions on Russia's economy affect energy exports, financial flows and the commodity markets Russia supplies.

nfe8d2e3c17.headline: What the latest Aussie retail sales data implies for ASX 200 investors awaiting an RBA interest rate cut
nfe8d2e3c17.summary: The latest Australian retail sales data was assessed for its implications for ASX 200 investors awaiting the Reserve Bank of Australia's first interest rate cut of 2025. The analysis focuses on the outlook for monetary policy.
nfe8d2e3c17.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which influences borrowing costs, the Australian dollar and equity valuations on the ASX 200.

n80ccea12ff.headline: Greggs issues warning to customers as it says price rises are a
n80ccea12ff.summary: Greggs raised prices on a number of items in July 2024, including a 5p increase on sausage rolls. The bakery chain has issued a warning to customers about price rises.
n80ccea12ff.why: Greggs is a UK bakery and food-to-go chain, and its pricing reflects food and wage cost pressures across the UK retail sector.

n1cc804d0fd.headline: Singapore shares retreat after Fed December minutes; STI down 0.6%
n1cc804d0fd.summary: Singapore shares fell after the Federal Reserve's December minutes, with the STI down 0.6% and losers outnumbering gainers 281 to 222.
n1cc804d0fd.why: The Straits Times Index tracks Singapore's largest listed companies and is a benchmark for Southeast Asian equities.

n403f4b7b60.headline: Exact date millions of workers will get pay rise this year
n403f4b7b60.summary: The UK minimum wage is due to rise by 6.7% from April, raising the legal minimum pay employers must provide by age.
n403f4b7b60.why: Minimum wage increases raise labour costs for employers, particularly in retail, hospitality and care sectors.

n722edb2daa.headline: Greggs issues warning to customers as it says price rises are a
n722edb2daa.summary: Greggs raised prices on a number of items in July 2024, including a 5p increase on sausage rolls, and has warned customers about further rises.
n722edb2daa.why: Greggs is a large UK bakery chain, and its pricing reflects food and labour cost pressures across UK retail.

n7dcc07b36b.headline: China's BYD Reports Soaring NEV Sales in 2024
n7dcc07b36b.summary: BYD's new energy vehicle sales jumped 41.26% year on year to more than 4.27 million units in 2024, according to a Shenzhen Stock Exchange report. The figures were cited from the exchange filing.
n7dcc07b36b.why: BYD is one of China's largest automakers and a major global seller of battery electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles, making its sales a key gauge of EV demand.

nb16d81cb9f.headline: Editorial: Nicor Gas’ delivery rates have doubled in six years, and now it wants another $309 million. Enough.
nb16d81cb9f.summary: Nicor Gas delivery rates have doubled in six years, and the utility now seeks another $309 million, according to a Yahoo News editorial. The editorial opposes the request.
nb16d81cb9f.why: Nicor Gas is a natural gas distributor serving customers in Illinois, and its rate requests are set by state regulators and affect household and business energy costs.

nf7a0d9fcea.headline: Dutch home sales prices shot up 11.5% to a record average of €483,000 at the end of 2024
nf7a0d9fcea.summary: Dutch home sale prices rose 11.5% year on year to a record average of €483,000 in the last quarter of 2024, according to realtor association NVM. The price was up €9,000 from the third quarter.
nf7a0d9fcea.why: House prices influence household wealth, mortgage risk and consumer spending, and are closely tracked by banks and central banks.

n859892c9e8.headline: Festive cheer for M&S and Tesco - but can retailers weather 2025 economic challenges?
n859892c9e8.summary: Festive trading numbers from Marks & Spencer and Tesco were positive. The Scotsman said 2025 could prove one of the toughest years in recent times for the wider UK retail sector.
n859892c9e8.why: Marks & Spencer and Tesco are major UK retailers, and their trading updates are read as signals for consumer spending across Britain.

impacts.name: Tesco
impacts.why: Tesco's positive festive numbers point to stronger seasonal sales in the same market.

neb9609bba6.headline: U.S. stock markets close to honor former President Jimmy Carter
neb9609bba6.summary: The New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq will both observe Thursday's national day of mourning for former President Jimmy Carter, in a Wall Street tradition dating to 1865.
neb9609bba6.why: The NYSE and Nasdaq are the two largest U.S. stock exchanges, and their closures affect trading schedules for global investors.

source.name: Northern Public Radio: WNIJ and WNIU

sources.name: Northern Public Radio: WNIJ and WNIU

n3f29db4c9a.headline: Sweden Buys More Leopard 2 Tanks As Part Of Major Defense Build-Up
n3f29db4c9a.summary: Sweden is buying 44 German-made Leopard 2A8 tanks and upgrading 66 of its older models to the same standard as part of continued defence investment.
n3f29db4c9a.why: Defence procurement contracts flow to manufacturers such as Germany's KNDS and Rheinmetall, and reflect rising European military spending.

n5a93af5673.headline: China Expands Trade-in Scheme to Boost Economy with Discounts on Home Appliances and Vehicles
n5a93af5673.summary: China has expanded its trade-in scheme to more items, offering discounts of up to 20% on home appliances and vehicles. The measure aims to stimulate the slowing economy.
n5a93af5673.why: Consumer trade-in subsidies are a fiscal tool used by Beijing to boost domestic demand, which matters for China's appliance, auto and retail sectors.

ne15a6146c6.headline: Central bank seen cutting key rate by 50 basis points - bond market
ne15a6146c6.summary: The Bank of Thailand is expected to cut rates twice, totalling 50 basis points, starting in the second quarter this year, the Bond Market Association said.
ne15a6146c6.why: The Bank of Thailand sets the country's policy interest rate, which influences borrowing costs, the baht and local bond yields.

n36ab8bb21f.headline: German drug firm Stada lines up new chairman and board ahead of IPO
n36ab8bb21f.summary: Private equity-backed German drugmaker Stada has lined up a new independent chairman and board ahead of a listing planned this year.
n36ab8bb21f.why: Stada is a German generic drugmaker, and an initial public offering would allow its private equity owners to sell shares to public investors.

na2d9738cd8.headline: Markets decline in early trade on unabated foreign fund outflows
na2d9738cd8.summary: The 30-share BSE Sensex dropped 284.12 points to 77,864.37 in early trade. Foreign funds continued to withdraw money from the market.
na2d9738cd8.why: The BSE Sensex tracks 30 large Indian companies and is the country's best-known equity benchmark. Foreign portfolio flows are a major driver of its direction.

n927c048e2d.headline: SoftBank and Arm weigh acquiring Ampere Computing, source says
n927c048e2d.summary: SoftBank and Arm are considering an acquisition of Ampere Computing, which has drawn Arm's interest while exploring strategic options. The source said talks could still not materialise.
n927c048e2d.why: SoftBank is a Japanese conglomerate that owns Arm, whose chip designs underpin most smartphones. Ampere makes server processors used in cloud data centres.

neb0a9f9a05.headline: 996 bitcoin mining devices seized in Chon Buri
neb0a9f9a05.summary: Authorities seized 996 bitcoin mining devices in Chon Buri, Thailand. Operators were also accused of stealing electricity to run the power-hungry rigs.
neb0a9f9a05.why: Bitcoin mining consumes large amounts of electricity, and enforcement against unauthorised mining affects power utilities and the crypto supply chain.

n7b9c90b16f.headline: Toronto Stocks Steady With U.S. Markets Closed
n7b9c90b16f.summary: Shares on Canada's main exchange were little changed overall while U.S. equity markets remained closed. Investors looked ahead to jobs data due at the end of the week.
n7b9c90b16f.why: The Toronto Stock Exchange is Canada's main equity market, and its trading reflects domestic economic conditions and global risk sentiment.

n77ef41b303.headline: Enbridge Pipeline Expansion Up and Running
n77ef41b303.summary: A natural gas pipeline expansion across southwestern Ontario is up and running. The C$358 million Panhandle Regional Expansion Project began construction on June 16, 2024.
n77ef41b303.why: Enbridge is a major Canadian energy infrastructure company operating pipelines that transport oil and natural gas across North America.

impacts.name: Enbridge
impacts.why: The completed expansion adds natural gas pipeline capacity to serve growing demand in the region.

n4159f840d3.headline: Run-up to Budget 2025: Restore 182 days residency rule for visiting NRIs and PIOs
n4159f840d3.summary: India plans to reintroduce the 182-day residency rule for NRIs, affecting tax residency and cross-border investment planning.
n4159f840d3.why: Tax residency rules influence NRI investment flows and compliance costs for foreign investors in India.

n26259a5ed0.headline: Investors who bought this ASX 200 dividend stock at the start of 2019 have already received almost 3 times their cash back in dividends
n26259a5ed0.summary: Investors in this ASX 200 dividend stock since 2019 have received almost three times their initial investment in dividends.
n26259a5ed0.why: High dividend yields can attract income-focused investors and impact the stock's valuation.

n20539a6bf7.headline: FG’s bold move to tackle food insecurity
n20539a6bf7.summary: The Nigerian government plans to invest N1 billion in agricultural polytechnics and universities to enhance food security through farming.
n20539a6bf7.why: Investment in agriculture can influence food supply, rural development, and economic stability in Nigeria.

n3d5d04e258.headline: Reliance Jio steps up 5G monetisation plans ahead of possible listing
n3d5d04e258.summary: Reliance Jio aims to add 1 million AirFiber customers within 30 days, boosting 5G network monetisation ahead of a possible IPO in late 2025.
n3d5d04e258.why: Reliance Jio is India's largest telecom operator; its 5G monetisation strategy and IPO plans are closely watched by investors.
n3d5d04e258.why_moved: The accelerated 5G monetisation and subscriber growth prospects increased investor interest ahead of the IPO.
